branch.newHint: A separate copy of this app with its own URL, data and secrets. Nothing merges back: Switch sends its build to the app.
branch.name: Name
branch.namePattern: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter, up to 24 characters.
branch.copyDataHint: Copies rows and blobs. The branch then always needs a key.
branch.publicHint: Anyone with the URL can call it. Off: calls need an API key.
branch.empty: Create one to try a change on its own URL before it reaches visitors.

rollback.migrationsStay_one: This migration stays applied, so version {{version}} runs against the newer schema:
rollback.migrationsStay_other: These {{count}} migrations stay applied, so version {{version}} runs against the newer schema:
rollback.migrationsUnknown: Could not check which migrations stay applied.
rollback.dataStays: Data written by the newer version stays.
rollback.envCurrent: Env and secrets are not versioned: the older code gets today's values.
rollback.inFlight: Requests and tasks already running on the live version finish there first.

wasm.title: Or upload a WebAssembly component
wasm.hint: Choose a .wasm file instead of a template. The app runs it as a WASM service.
wasm.notWasm: This file is not a WebAssembly component.

gitAfterCreate: To deploy from git, create the app, then use Connect a repository on its overview.
previewsNeedRepo: Previews come from pull requests of a connected repository. A project admin can turn them on.
diffTooLarge: Too many changes to show line by line.

alerts.urlFormat: Enter a full URL, starting with https://.
alerts.urlNotPublic: Use a public HTTPS address. HTTP, private addresses and this machine are refused.
alerts.secretFormat: Use 16 to 256 printable characters, without spaces.
alerts.tokenFormat: This does not look like a Telegram bot token.
alerts.chatFormat: Use a numeric chat ID or an @channel name.

testOther.network: Test message failed: the address could not be reached in time.
testOther.blocked: Test message failed: the address now resolves to a private network, so nothing was sent.
testOther.config: Test message failed: the saved channel settings cannot be read. Enter them again.

firstRun.title: Next steps
firstRun.keyHint: This app needs a token: replace $TOKEN with an invoke token from Settings, Access.
firstRun.editCodeHint: Change the handler and deploy a new version.
firstRun.logsHint: Every request and console.log appears there.
firstRun.domainHint: Serve the app from your own hostname.

ingress.methodsHint: Turn this off to accept only the methods you tick.
ingress.methodsRequired: Tick at least one method, or choose All methods.
ingress.prefixesHint: None means every path reaches the app.
ingress.ipHint: None means every address can reach the app.
ingress.defaultLimitHint: Counts all requests to this app. Leave empty or 0 for no default limit.
ingress.burstHint: Short peak allowed above the rate. It is never lower than the rate.
ingress.numberInvalid: Use a whole number, 0 or more.
ingress.rulesRelation: A request must pass both: the first matching rule below, and the default limit above.
ingress.accessMoved: Who can call this app is set in the Access tab.

triggers.summary: Access and allowed requests are edited in the app's settings.

backups.toChange: To change, edit this in rt.toml

backups.whyRunning: One backup runs at a time. This one will finish first.
backups.whyUnknown: The node did not report its backup status, so a backup cannot be started from here.

backups.restoreHint: Restoring is done offline on the node, not from the console. Stop the node, then check the archive and restore it into an empty data directory:
